candidates.description: This vector represents geographical locations, destinations, and places of interest.
This feature vector represents the concept of causing a change, effect, or action.
This vector activates for French words related to variety, difference, and conceptual diversity.
This feature vector represents terms and lexical fragments related to instructional guidance, manuals, or informational assistance.
These tokens represent common French adverbs and adverbial modifiers used to express time, frequency, degree, or logical connection.
This vector activates on common French noun and verb prefixes with acute or grave accents.
This vector represents geographical entities and nationalities, specifically focusing on European countries and related terms.
This feature vector represents Latinate derivational roots and morphological stems, particularly those involving prefixes combined with bound roots related to composition, participation, and parts.
This vector represents proper nouns, French vocabulary, and words associated with themes of isolation or introspection.
This feature vector activates strongly on tokens containing the letters "gr" or "gr"-related phonetic and spelling patterns across various words.
